summary: Verified BUG FIX 1 (always 3-column layout, A5 landscape for <=3, A4 portrait for 4-6, mixed pages for >6, empty slots as blank bordered boxes) and BUG FIX 2 (hardcoded 6-line FROM address 'Hariram Home Needs / B12, Sidharth Apartment / Balakrishnan Street / West Mambalam / Chennai - 600033 / Ph : 9500021456'). Wrote new pytest suite test_iteration7_address_pdf.py using pypdf + pdfplumber to inspect mediabox sizes, per-page text extraction (counting FROM-line occurrences per filled slot vs blank slot), and image XObject presence. Ran full frontend regression against admin 2FA login + per-row and bulk 'Print Address' buttons on /admin/orders/pending. All 13 new backend tests pass. Frontend flow works end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key HR2609131318' — duplicate order-number key when rendering rows. Non-blocking but should be fixed to keep list stable (probably re-using orderNumber as key while two seeded orders share the same number, or a stray duplicate in DB). Reproduce: open /admin/orders/pending — warning fires in browser console.

action_items: Optional: fix React duplicate-key warning on /admin/orders/pending (order HR2609131318 appears to have a duplicate row / repeated key).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_pdf.py: _company() is still imported/used only by pending & invoice PDFs. FROM_ADDRESS_LINES is correctly hardcoded — good. Consider extracting it into config/company.json under a new field like 'shippingFromLines' so admins can edit without redeploy (not required for this bug).

admin_pdf.py _draw_box: logo image is redrawn per filled slot; reportlab dedupes the XObject so the resulting PDF is small — verified (PdfReader shows 1 image XObject per page even when 3 filled slots).
admin_pdf.py: If order['phone'] is missing, TO block omits phone line silently; ok.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login+2FA, per-row PDF download, bulk PDF download)

seed_data_creation: None — reused existing 62 CONFIRMED orders in DB from prior iterations. Tests dynamically pull first N via GET /api/admin/orders/pending.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration7_address_pdf.py extends iteration_6 coverage with structural PDF assertions: mediabox sizes (A5 landscape 595.28x419.53pt, A4 portrait 595.28x841.89pt), FROM-line frequency per page (should equal number of filled slots), and blank-slot leakage check (single order -> FROM appears exactly once). If order count in DB < 7 in future runs, test_seven_orders_a4_plus_a5 will skip; seed more CONFIRMED orders via /api/orders storefront flow to re-enable.
rca of the issue: Not a bug this iteration — both fixes verified working. Prior wrong output was due to (a) A5 being portrait instead of landscape and (b) FROM being read from company.json giving a slightly different multi/single-line variant. New _draw_page always sets cols=3 and A5=landscape(A5); FROM_ADDRESS_LINES is a module-level constant so no config drift.
